data.one_liner: Render HTML content as native Flutter widgets with correctness and extensibility.
data.what_it_does: Parses HTML strings and CSS into structured Flutter widgets, supporting over 70 popular tags, custom styling, inline attributes, and extensibility hooks for links, images, and custom builders.
use_when: You need to display rich HTML content or blog posts inside a Flutter app.
You want support for common HTML formatting, tables, lists, and CSS inline styles without building a full WebView.
avoid_when: You need full browser capabilities like JavaScript execution or complex web application hosting (use a WebView instead).
You need native support for audio, video, or SVG out-of-the-box in the core package without adding separate extension packages.
strengths: High correctness and extensive support for CSS styles and HTML tags.
Extensible widget factory and custom styling builders.
Supports multiple render modes like Column, ListView, or SliverList for performance.
weaknesses: Does not support full JavaScript execution or interactive web apps.
Some rich elements like audio, video, and SVG require separate extension packages.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package to use the HtmlWidget.
data.minimal_example:
HtmlWidget( '''

Heading

A paragraph with strong text.

''', textStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 14), )
